name: United Premium Foods
old_description: We are full-service co-manufacturer of AAFCO Human Grade and fresh Premium Pet food. Our capabilities range from vet-formulated recipes and palatability testing to high scale production for both raw and cooked premium pet food.
about:
United Premium Foods operates from Woodbridge, New Jersey, where it runs a USDA-, FDA- and SQF 2000 Level 2-certified facility. The company serves as a full-service co-manufacturer for human-grade and fresh premium pet food, while also producing a range of human food products including ready-to-eat meats.

The 110,000-square-foot plant includes segregated production and ready-to-eat rooms, and its cold-storage wing offers one million cubic feet of temperature-controlled space served by an AS/RS computerized crane system. Capabilities span R&D and recipe formulation, palatability testing, raw-ingredient sourcing, cooking, blending, packaging, labeling, slicing, curing, smoking and ready-to-eat packaging. The facility can handle small R&D runs through to millions of pounds per year for both raw and cooked pet food as well as cured and smoked meat products.

Customers include pet-food brands seeking AAFCO-compliant human-grade products and meat processors needing co-packing for sliced Italian meats and other cured items. The company's location in the Northeast Transportation Corridor—minutes from the New Jersey Turnpike, Garden State Parkway and Interstates 78 and 80—gives it ready access to major ports, airports and a dense supplier base, allowing national distribution from a central New Jersey hub.

United Premium Foods emphasizes a proven track record of optimizing the entire production process from formulation to final packaging, backed by GFSI-recognized SQF Level 2 certification and HACCP adherence. Its stated values—quality, collaboration, innovation, reliability and integrity—underscore a focus on long-term partnerships and transparent, fair dealing.
